program.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Civil Engineering

requirement.applicantContext: Direct IB Diploma entry to Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Civil Engineering under the UTB 2026 prospectus.
requirement.subjectNotes: Mathematics at HL 4 or SL 5, plus at least HL 4 in one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Design and Technology, or Geography.
requirement.conditions: This is the 2026 prospectus minimum for direct first-year entry. Meet the university English requirement as well.
